resources.string: View-only. Android 10+ does not let an ordinary app list every other app’s process, or read per-process CPU / memory for other apps. This list is the widest view Android allows without system / root access: running processes, running services, and apps used in the last 24 hours (Usage Access). CPU / memory are shown only for this app itself; other rows show “—” instead of invented numbers.
Usage Access is not granted, so the list will be short. Grant it in Settings to see apps used in the last 24 hours.

Cell tower log: records the serving tower when it changes — network type, cell ID, TAC / LAC, signal and operator. Android gives no way to verify a tower is genuine, so a change is a clue to notice, not proof of a fake tower. Cell IDs need location permission (Android 10+).
Grant location / phone access for tower log
